About The System

Your Spidey Notes HQ

SpideyNotes is a Spider-Man–inspired note-taking system built to make productivity fun, engaging, and heroic. Developed by Simon Umadac as part of the course Application Development and Emerging Technology, this project blends creativity with technology to showcase how fandom can meet functionality.

Just like Spider-Man swings through the city with agility and precision, SpideyNotes helps you capture ideas, tasks, and reminders with speed and style. Powered by React, JavaScript, CSS, and MongoDB, it delivers a dynamic interface with a Spidey flair, weaving your thoughts into action and sticking with you when you need it most.

SpideyNotes proves that even everyday tools can be spectacular. Whether you’re jotting down your next big idea or organizing daily responsibilities, this system is here to help you stay on track — responsibly, heroically, and with a touch of web-slinging fun.
